We have a short supply of people willing to defend the Constitution when it matters most. I won’t stop being one of them.

Video

At a time when we’re already facing a $2 trillion deficit, proposals to add hundreds of billions more in spending should concern everyone. Our long-term threat isn’t foreign invasion, it’s the growing debt and the stability of our dollar. @CNBC

Video

We don’t have a revenue problem, we have a spending problem.

My Penny Plan would cut just 6% a year and balance the budget in five years. That’s it.

Show markets we’re serious about fiscal discipline, and the economy will respond.

Time to hold the line on spending.

Video

We must pass the SAVE America Act!


Cause of America (@CauseAmerica)

“We’ve run 50–60 MILLION voter records and found HUNDREDS OF THOUSANDS who should not be on the rolls—dead voters, movers, duplicates, even non-citizens. This is not ‘a conspiracy theory.’ It’s data.” @HarmeetKDhillon 

This is exactly why Cause of America was founded: corrupt voter rolls + mass mail ballots + no real ID checks = a system BUILT for abuse.

We don’t fix this with press releases. We fix it with citizen-led canv

Americans are increasingly worried about the cost of health care, and they should be. Rising premiums and out-of-pocket expenses are squeezing families nationwide. My Health Marketplace for All Act empowers consumers to negotiate better rates and bring real competition back to the system.
news.gallup.com/poll/707732/…

Our debt is a national security crisis.


Tom Elliott (@tomselliott)

Sen. @RandPaul on the $700 billion the Trump Admin is asking for Iran/increased Pentagon spending: "Our threat is not from foreign countries invading the U.S. Our threat is from the destruction of our dollar. Our threat is from the debt."

Video
  





— https://nitter.net/tomselliott/status/2044034679603364036#m

Great new book by Mark A. Monoscalco 

The Forbidden Idea: Hidden Truths About Individual Liberty, Economic Freedom, Political Philosophy, and History a.co/d/02hzTuCc

$88B a month, $22B a week. That's how much we're spending just on interest! 

While the majority of Congress will continue to ignore this crisis, I will continue to sound the alarm, vote against reckless spending bills, and provide solutions like my Six Penny Plan.
fortune.com/2026/04/09/us-go…

FISA was created to spy on foreign enemies. Then Washington turned it on Americans. 

My Fourth Amendment Restoration and Protection Act stops FISA spying on Americans and forces real warrants in real courts.

Can you trust the government? Absolutely not. That's why our founding fathers created the 4th Amendment. My bill, the Fourth Amendment Restoration and Protection Act, will create more protections to protect the right of privacy for citizens.

Video

No American should have to beg the government for permission to exercise a God-given right. The National Constitutional Carry Act would restore full recognition of the Second Amendment across all 50 states.

Enjoyed meeting  Liberty’s Defender in South America (wonder where he got that idea for a chainsaw?)



Video

Our debt is our biggest threat to our national security. A strong solution to this problem would be to pass my Six Penny Plan that would balance the budget in five years.
zerohedge.com/political/debt…

While blue states rush to ban guns, I’m fighting for your right to carry across state lines with the National Constitutional Carry Act.


The Baltimore Banner (@BaltimoreBanner)

Maryland lawmakers approve bill banning popular Glock handgun sales buff.ly/ukdsdWL




— https://nitter.net/BaltimoreBanner/status/2041954735305937002#m

For years, intelligence agencies have abused FISA to search Americans’ communications without a warrant.

My Fourth Amendment Restoration and Protection Act ends these backdoor searches once and for all.

If the government wants your data, they should get a warrant.
Law-abiding Americans do not need a government permit to exercise a constitutional right? Do you agree?

I believe that your constitutional rights shouldn't stop at state lines, that's why I am co-sponsoring @BasedMikeLee's National Constitutional Carry Act, which will allow law-abiding citizens to carry concealed nationwide.
Your constitutional rights are not negotiable. Whether it’s the Second Amendment or the Fourth, I’m fighting to restore the protections Washington has been eroding for decades.
